name: map-card
description: One explainer on the series map: its code (e.g. A4), its title, its one-line aha and the file to open (a relative link). Compact mode hides the aha.

aha.description: the one idea it teaches, in one line

file.description: the built file to open, relative, e.g. `a4-grep.html`

compact.description: hide the aha (for the whole-map view)

example.title: grep: finding the needle
example.aha: grep returns only the matching lines and where they came from.
